options.content:
Data-source note (2026-07): The Redfish/BMC exporter is not currently scraped into VictoriaMetrics — redfish_fast_up, redfish_temperature_celsius and redfish_fan_rpm return no series, and there are no fan-RPM, SEL/event-log or coolant-leak metrics in the TSDB. The previous single HTML "BMC grid" panel queried those dead metrics and rendered empty.
Hardware health here is derived from the metrics that do exist: up{job="node-exporter"} (reachability), node_hwmon_temp_celsius / node_hwmon_temp_crit_celsius / node_hwmon_temp_alarm (board / NIC / NVMe sensors), node_edac_uncorrectable_errors_total (memory), and DCGM DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP / DCGM_FI_DEV_MEMORY_TEMP / DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_VIOLATION (GPU thermal & power).
When the Redfish exporter is deployed, add issue tables for BMC down (redfish_fast_up==0), fan failures (redfish_fan_rpm below threshold), power-supply faults and SEL critical events. XID / NVLink-error events live in Loki (nvis-loki), not in this metrics store.
